translations.web: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
translations.bsb: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.
translations.kjv: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
translations.asv: My beloved is unto me as a bundle of myrrh, That lieth betwixt my breasts.
